title: Experimental maturity timeline and cross-functional artifact map
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a repeatable experimental maturity timeline (pre-flight -> smoke -> limited ramp -> full rollout -> postmortem) and map all required artefacts and owners across PM, Eng, Design, SRE, and Data Science. The goal is to standardize milestone artifacts and decision gates so that every A/B test, canary, and staged rollout has predictable instrumentation, gating criteria, and ownership before any traffic shift.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical maturity timeline graphic stored in Confluence with phase definitions and expected deliverables for each phase
A checklist template (pre-flight checklist) that teams can attach to Linear tickets, including telemetry queries and dashboards to create
Defined owners for signal collection, dashboarding, and escalation for each experiment type
A set of guardrail metric thresholds and rollback signatures documented and approved by SRE and Product
Two pilot experiments run using the process with post-pilot retros showing fewer instrumentation regressions
A short how-to doc for PMs and Eng to plan experiments and request SRE coverage for high-risk canaries
rollout_milestones: Phase 0 - Pre-flight (artifact creation): PRD snippet, target cohort definition, primary/secondary metrics, telemetry hooks listed, alerting owners assigned
Phase 1 - Smoke (very low traffic): sanity checks for end-to-end paths, baseline-liveness checks, basic latency/throughput monitoring
Phase 2 - Limited ramp (cohort expansion): threshold checks enabled, error budgets observed, canary pass/fail evaluated after 24h
Phase 3 - Graduated ramp (majority ramp): multi-metric guardrail pass, ops runbook attached, SLO/latency delta within target
Phase 4 - Postflight (analysis): 7-14 day evaluation window, significance testing for key metrics, quality regression review, formal close-out and learnings captured
decision_gates: Pre-flight sign-off: PM + Eng + Design + DS agree on success metrics and instrumentation; vocal approval in ticket comments
Smoke pass: no critical errors, basic latency within 2x baseline, DS sanity checks OK
Limited ramp pass: guardrail metrics within defined thresholds for 24h and sample sizes meet min-power calculations
Full ramp pass: all secondary metrics stable and no unresolved P0/P1 incidents; OK from SRE for scale
Rollback criteria: one or more guardrail signals breach sustained for 30 minutes OR a single P0 incident attributed to the experiment
instrumentation_requirements: Dashboard: per-cohort latency, error rate, token cost, and quality regression metric (embedding similarity / hallucination proxy)
Tracing hooks for request id and model variant used
Data pipeline: churned datasets labelled by cohort and experiment id (for offline analyses)
Automated alerts wired to oncall with runbook links
Synthetic monitors that exercise key user flows once per 5 minutes during ramp
stakeholders: Data Science: Miguel Santos (metric definitions + significance testing)
Product Ops: Heather Kim (process and template maintenance)
risks: Insufficient telemetry leads to blind rollouts and late detection of regressions
Unclear ownership for rollback decisions causing coordination lag during incidents
Metric selection mismatch (optimizing for cost at the expense of quality) without explicit guardrails
Experiment-induced increased tail latency causing user-visible degradations across other services
